fields.Name: T47 - Data Explorer Entity Tree Navigation
fields.Description: Verifies that the Data Explorer left-hand entity tree can be expanded to reach the AssociationDemo demo entities and that opening one navigates to its grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Navigate to Data Explorer > Data (use the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, NOT the Ctrl+K search). Use the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box to find an AssociationDemo demo entity — type 'Members' (or 'Events'/'Products') and click the matching entity node. Verify the entity's grid loads with rows. Use the sidebar 'Search entities...' box rather than expanding group chevrons. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait. Success = the searched entity opens and its grid of records is displayed.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Data Explorer Data section is open with the entity tree visible on the left
The entity tree shows AssociationDemo demo entities (e.g. Members, Events, Products)
One of those entities was clicked and its row grid is displayed on the right
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
